title: nonignorable: Shadow-Variable Screens and Sharp Sensitivity Scans for Nonignorable Missing Outcomes
description: R package with two tools for an outcome that is missing not at random. shadow_screen() asks whether a candidate variable can serve as a shadow variable, reporting its relevance for the outcome and its violation of the exclusion restriction on a common scale. sharp_scan() and its relatives return the sharp identified set under a bound on the ratio of response propensities between outcome values, for a rate, a mean, a distribution function and the difference between two groups, with debiased estimates and confidence sets. Documentation: https://buecker.ms/nonignorable/
